ideas.pitch: A fuzzer and automated vulnerability scanner specifically designed to find hidden logical flaws and flags inside buggy Qiskit quantum circuits.
ideas.problem_statement: Problems may involve quantum circuits, Qiskit programming, probability, quantum information, cryptography, logic, debugging, data interpretation or other related areas.
ideas.title: QiskitCircuitFuzz
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a hard engineering problem by automating the tedious manual code analysis required in quantum CTFs, giving teams an unfair speed advantage.

ideas.pitch: A real-time visual debugger for quantum states, entanglement metrics, and gate operations during interactive CTF challenge solving.
ideas.problem_statement: Depending on the final challenge design, problems may involve quantum circuits, Qiskit programming, probability, quantum information, cryptography, logic, debugging, data interpretation or other related areas.
ideas.title: EntangleScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a live, highly polished interactive demo that makes complex quantum debugging visually intuitive for judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic solver toolkit implementing BB84 protocol analysis, quantum key distribution (QKD) eavesdropping detection, and lattice cryptography attack vectors.
ideas.problem_statement: Depending on the final challenge design, problems may involve quantum circuits, Qiskit programming, probability, quantum information, cryptography, logic, debugging, data interpretation or other related areas.
ideas.title: QuantumKeyCrack
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles genuine cryptographic complexity in quantum information security, matching the rigorous technical expectations of a CTF competition.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative command center for quantum CTF teams featuring shared flag submission, live challenge board scraping, and integrated Qiskit notebook scratchpads.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams can divide tasks among members according to their strengths, making communication and collaborative problem solving important.
ideas.title: CTFRanger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the collaborative team coordination aspect emphasized in the event rules, streamlining multi-person task division.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted prompt and code generation harness specialized in translating cryptic quantum math problems into executable Qiskit scripts to extract hidden flags.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive a collection of challenges in which they must analyze information, solve technical problems, interpret quantum concepts, decode clues or complete computational tasks to obtain hidden flags.
ideas.title: OracleOracle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages agentic code generation tuned specifically for niche quantum algorithms, showcasing a live, working accelerator for rapid flag discovery.
